app.name: Matchboard (sample)
app.description: Ranks which fictional ocean-tech startups each fictional funder should meet. Score out of 100 = thesis fit (0-40) + stage fit (0-30) + traction (0-30). All data is invented sample data.

pages.title: Matches
pages.desc: Every startup-to-funder match ranked by score, with a sector filter and a score filter

pages.title: Startup
pages.desc: One startup: its score and the three parts, why it fits, its best funder, evidence, and the next step
